'''Helboars''' are demon [[boar]]s found in the [[Blasted Lands]]. Due to their proximity to the [[Dark Portal]], they have been genetically warped from regular boars by the [[fel]] energies.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|53|Genetic Alteration Anomaly!}}</ref>

==Objective of==
* {{questlong|Neutral|52|Warrior Kinship|class=warrior}}

==Notable drops==
* They drop [[Blasted Boar Lung]]s for the quests {{questlong|Neutral|50|A Boar's Vitality}}, {{questlong|Neutral|50|Rage of Ages}}, {{questlong|Neutral|50|Salt of the Scorpok}}, {{questlong|Neutral|50|Snickerfang Jowls}}, {{questlong|Neutral|50|Spirit of the Boar}} and {{questlong|Neutral|50|The Decisive Striker}}.
